=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:420-833 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `JUDGE_EFFECTIVE_REASONING_EFFORT` is initialized before the judge retry loop and never updated when a later judge attempt succeeds.
  WHY: If the judge only succeeds after backing off to a lower reasoning level, the fix step still runs with the initial higher level and can re-trigger the same context-exhaustion failure.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:439, 833 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `JUDGE_EFFECTIVE_REASONING_EFFORT` is set before the judge loop and is used by the fix step, but it never tracks the reasoning level that actually succeeded.
  WHY: If the judge fails at `xhigh` and succeeds at `high`, the fix step still runs at `xhigh`, so context exhaustion can recur during fix application.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:441, 507, 513, 527, 833 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `JUDGE_EFFECTIVE_REASONING_EFFORT` is set to `${JUDGE_ATTEMPT_LEVELS[0]}` before the loop and is never updated on success.
  WHY: When a later, lower-effort attempt succeeds, the fix step still uses the original highest level and can hit the same context-exhaustion failure the backoff ladder was meant to avoid.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

  WHY: The fix step then uses the stale initial level instead of the successful lower level, which can re-trigger context exhaustion and undermine progressive backoff.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

  WHY: If the judge succeeds only after backoff, the fix step still runs at `xhigh` (or the starting level), which can re-trigger the same context-exhaustion failure the ladder was designed to avoid.
